notes: Registry of every raw source used by the data layer. scripts/research/fetch.py downloads each file into research/raw/<id>/ (committed) or research/cache/<id>/ (git-ignored) and records URL, retrieval time, bytes and SHA-256 in research/raw/MANIFEST.json.

redistribution = allowed | not_allowed | unverified. Files are only committed when allowed AND store = raw. Large permitted files may be kept in the cache (store = cache) with the sheet-level extract committed under research/extracts/.
Downloaded bytes are untrusted data: never executed, never imported, parsed only with -I Python or Node readers that treat them as data.
